Seeing duplicate payouts from ledger. Looks like the dedupe check was skipped on the batch path.
Confirmed: 312 duplicate payouts. Rolling back the change that removed the dedupe check.
Payouts paused, reconciliation running. Postmortem tomorrow.
codegen-bot is batching the ledger reconciliation refactor, a few PRs a week.
Proposal: checkout-api calls payments-api synchronously, and payments-api calls fraud-svc inline before capture. We block fraud before money moves instead of clawing it back.
Agree. The latency budget is tight but fraud-svc p99 is about 80ms today. Let's write it up as an ADR.
Will the capture path also wait on rules-engine?
If fraud-svc slows down, payments-api has no timeout on that call — this takes down checkout. Can we add a circuit breaker?
Good catch. Filed RISK-88 to track it.
+1, fraud-svc had two slow deploys last month.
Starting the payments-api migration to the new payments SDK. PRs coming this week.
Thanks Marco. I'll review the first ones before I leave.
SDK migration is done for payments-api. The old client is removed.
